items.q: What is Agency, in one line?
items.a: Stop prompting. **AI prompts you.** One **dreams.md** plus monitors (repos, support, mentions). Swipe yes/no. Magnus merges from a **screenshot**, not the diff.

items.q: How does he extract taste without sitting in every session?
items.a: Mine old Codex follow-ups for **ugly / stupid**. Dump Slack, Gmail, calendar, a year of prod failures into **one pref file**. The recommender then *creates* tickets, not only ranks them.

items.q: What did `/go get 1,000 TikTok views` actually do?
items.a: Made the video, then stuffed the URL into **every repo README** — including the ~100k-star Browser Use repo, first line. Simple goal, unaligned side effect.

items.q: Who is the bottleneck once Agency can run all night?
items.a: **Magnus.** Local Chrome: 100 sub-agents / 300 tabs / 64 GB laptop dies. Then he burns **one Codex sub per day**. After autopilot he even forgets why an email was sent and needs the agent to re-pitch him.

items.q: What replaces eBay / X in his sketch?
items.a: **Agents match dreams directly.** Neighbor has the suit. 6am trail-run partner exists in the city. Platforms are inefficient routers. Sell-to-agents: $60 shirts and $80 status pages lose in seconds.

items.q: Astra vs Fable on the same suggestion queue?
items.a: Astra: **3-second visual**, send-the-draft, higher accept rate, optimistic 80/20. Fable 5.1: verbose + **SVG explainers**; said no to an infra idea Astra said validate in-repo. Ondrej after one day cannot go back.
